name: msg_1_license_usagenlojia_system
text:
1. License & Usage
Lojia System is licensed for commercial POS and shift management. All data generated on this device remains under the full control of the store owner.

2. Shift Ledger Accuracy
Cashiers and managers are responsible for entering accurate drawer counts, receipts, and cash movements.

3. Cloud Sync & Backups
Cloud backups to Google Drive are encrypted (AES-256) and managed under your selected Google account credentials.

4. Updates
Periodic updates may include feature enhancements, security patches, and regulatory compliance updates.

name: msg_1_data_collectionnlojia_system
text:
1. Data Collection
Lojia System processes sales transactions, inventory catalogs, cashier shifts, and business contact information locally on your Android device.

2. Security & Biometrics
Biometric data (fingerprint or face unlock) is authenticated strictly through Android BiometricPrompt hardware keystore. No biometric templates are stored in the database.

3. Third-Party Integrations
Optional integrations (e.g. WhatsApp, Google Drive, Printers) operate exclusively with explicit user permissions.

4. Data Retention
You may export or purge your local databases and audit logs at any time.
